alert_message_en: Milk chocolate contains methylxanthines and caffeine which relax the lower esophageal sphincter and stimulate stomach acid, potentially worsening ulcer symptoms. Limit or avoid.
alert_message_sw: Chokoleti la maziwa lina methylxanthines na kafeini zinazopumzisha sphincter na kuchochea asidi ya tumbo. Punguza au epuka.

alert_message_en: Sausages are highly processed and contain nitrates, preservatives, and high sodium which can irritate the stomach lining and worsen ulcer symptoms. Limit or avoid.
alert_message_sw: Soseji zinasindikwa sana na zina nitrati, viowevu, na chumvi nyingi vinavyowasha tumbo na kuzidisha vidonda. Punguza au epuka.

alert_message_en: Beef sausage is highly processed and contains nitrates, preservatives, and high sodium which can irritate the stomach lining and worsen ulcer symptoms. Limit or avoid.
alert_message_sw: Soseji ya nyama zinasindikwa sana na zina nitrati na chumvi nyingi vinavyowasha tumbo. Punguza au epuka.

alert_message_en: Pork sausage is highly processed and contains nitrates, preservatives, and high sodium which can irritate the stomach lining and worsen ulcer symptoms. Limit or avoid.
alert_message_sw: Soseji ya nguruwe zinasindikwa sana na zina nitrati na chumvi nyingi vinavyowasha tumbo. Punguza au epuka.

alert_message_en: Bacon is highly processed, high in sodium and nitrates, and often fried — all of which irritate the stomach lining and worsen ulcer symptoms. Avoid during flare-ups.
alert_message_sw: Bacon inasindikwa sana, chumvi nyingi, nitrati, na mara nyingi huwa imekaangwa — vyote vinavyowasha tumbo. Epuka wakati tumbo linapouma.

alert_message_en: Ham is highly processed and very high in sodium and nitrates which can irritate the stomach lining and worsen ulcer symptoms. Limit or avoid.
alert_message_sw: Ham inasindikwa sana na chumvi nyingi na nitrati vinavyowasha tumbo na kuzidisha vidonda. Punguza au epuka.

alert_message_en: Whole milk may temporarily soothe but then triggers acid rebound (increased acid production), potentially worsening ulcer symptoms. Use small amounts or choose low-fat alternatives.
alert_message_sw: Maziwa kamili yanaweza kutuliza kwa muda mfupi lakini kisha yanachochea asidi zaidi, kuzidisha vidonda. Tumia kidogo au chagua yenye mafuta kidogo.

alert_message_en: Condensed sweetened milk is very high in sugar and fat, which stimulates stomach acid and feeds harmful bacteria that can worsen ulcers. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Maziwa ya kopo yenye sukari yana sukari na mafuta mengi yanayochochea asidi na kuwabakisha wadudu wanaozidisha vidonda. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Soy sauce is extremely high in sodium (5000mg+ per 100g) and contains wheat/gluten which can irritate the stomach lining. Avoid completely during flare-ups.
alert_message_sw: Sosi ya soya ina chumvi nyingi kupita kiasi (mg 5000+) na gluteini inayoweza kuwash tumbo. Epuka kabisa wakati tumbo linapouma.

alert_message_en: Pickles are acidic and high in sodium, both of which can irritate the stomach lining and increase stomach acid. Use very small amounts or avoid during flare-ups.
alert_message_sw: Mcharifu ni wa asidi na chumvi nyingi zinazoweza kuwash tumbo na kuongeza asidi. Tumia kidogo sana au epuka wakati tumbo linapouma.

alert_message_en: Table salt directly irritates the stomach lining and increases stomach acid. PUD patients must limit total salt intake to less than 1 teaspoon (5g) per day.
alert_message_sw: Chumvi ya mezani inawasha ukuta wa tumbo moja kwa moja na kuongeza asidi. Wenye vidonda wasizidi kijiko kimoja (g 5) kwa siku.

alert_message_en: Plain yogurt contains probiotics that may help restore healthy gut bacteria and support ulcer healing. Choose unsweetened varieties.
alert_message_sw: Maziwa mgando ya kawaida lina probiotics zinazoweza kusaidia kurejesha bakteria za afya za tumbo na kusaidia kupona kwa vidonda. Chagua lisilo na sukari.

alert_message_en: Oatmeal is a gentle, high-fiber food that forms a protective coating in the stomach and can help soothe ulcer symptoms. Choose plain, unsweetened varieties.
alert_message_sw: Oatmeal ni chakula laini chenye nyuzi nyingi zinazounda kifuniko cha ulinzi tumboni na kufidia maumivu ya vidonda. Chagua lisilo na sukari.

alert_message_en: Ripe bananas are gentle on the stomach and contain compounds that may help protect the stomach lining and promote healing. A good choice for ulcer patients.
alert_message_sw: Ndizi mbivu ni laini tumboni na lina virutubisho vinavyoweza kulinda ukuta wa tumbo na kusaidia kupona. Chaguo zuri kwa wenye vidonda.

alert_message_en: Ripe mango is generally well-tolerated and provides vitamins that support healing. Avoid unripe mango which is more acidic.
alert_message_sw: Embe iliyokomaa kwa kawaida inakubalika vizuri na lina vitamini zinazosaidia kupona. Epuka embe isiyokomaa ambayo ni ya asidi zaidi.

alert_message_en: Ripe papaya contains papain which aids digestion and is gentle on the stomach. A good choice for ulcer patients in small portions.
alert_message_sw: Papai iliyokomaa lina papain inayosaidia kumeng'enya na ni laini tumboni. Chaguo zuri kwa wenye vidonda kwa kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Canned sardines in oil are high in sodium and the oil can increase stomach acid. The fish itself is nutritious but choose fresh or water-packed if possible.
alert_message_sw: Sardines zilizowekwa kwenye mafuta ni za chumvi nyingi na mafuta yanayoweza kuongeza asidi. Samaki ni wa lishe lakini chagua mbichi au zilizowekwa kwenye maji.

alert_message_en: Canned anchovies in oil are extremely high in sodium which can irritate the stomach lining. Use very small amounts or choose fresh alternatives.
alert_message_sw: Anchovies zilizowekwa kwenye mafuta ni za chumvi nyingi mno zinazoweza kuwash tumbo. Tumia kiasi kidogo sana au chagua mbichi.

alert_message_en: Salami is highly processed with nitrates, preservatives, and very high sodium — all of which irritate the stomach lining and can worsen ulcer symptoms. Limit or avoid.
alert_message_sw: Salami inasindikwa sana na nitrati, viowevu, na chumvi nyingi mno — vyote vinavyowasha tumbo na kuzidisha vidonda. Punguza au epuka.

alert_message_en: Durian is high in fat and can increase stomach acid production. Its strong smell may also trigger nausea in sensitive stomachs. Use small amounts.
alert_message_sw: Durian lina mafuta mengi yanayoweza kuongeza asidi ya tumbo. Harufu yake kali inaweza kusababisha kichefuchefu. Tumia kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Grapes are acidic and can increase stomach acid, potentially irritating an active ulcer. Use small amounts and avoid during flare-ups.
alert_message_sw: Zabibu ni za asidi na zinaweza kuongeza asidi ya tumbo. Tumia kiasi kidogo na epuka wakati tumbo linapouma.

alert_message_en: Pears are mildly acidic and can increase stomach acid. While generally gentle, use small amounts during active ulcer flare-ups.
alert_message_sw: Pears ni za asidi kidogo na zinaweza kuongeza asidi ya tumbo. Ingawa ni laini kwa kawaida, tumia kiasi kidogo wakati tumbo linapouma.

alert_message_en: Raspberries are acidic and contain small seeds which may be difficult to digest during active ulcer flare-ups. Use small amounts.
alert_message_sw: Raspberries ni za asidi na lina mbegu ndogo zinazoweza kuwa vigumu kusaga wakati tumbo linapouma. Tumia kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Canned green olives are high in sodium and may be preserved in acidic brine, both of which can irritate the stomach lining. Use very small amounts.
alert_message_sw: Mizeituni ya kopo ni ya chumvi nyingi na huwekwa kwenye chumvi ya asidi, zote zinazoweza kuwash tumbo. Tumia kiasi kidogo sana.

alert_message_en: Bacon is extremely high in sodium and saturated fat. Just 2 slices can contain over 700mg of sodium, nearly half the daily limit for HTN patients. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Bacon ina chumvi nyingi mno na mafuta yaliyoshiba. Vipande viwili tu vinaweza kuwa na mg 700 za chumvi, karibu nusu ya kiasi cha siku kwa wenye presha. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Ham is extremely high in sodium (often 1200mg+ per 100g) and nitrates. It causes rapid blood pressure spikes. HTN patients should avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Ham ina chumvi nyingi mno (mara nyingi mg 1200+) na nitrati. Hupandisha presha kwa kasi. Wenye presha wanapaswa kuiepuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Salami is extremely high in sodium (1800mg+ per 100g) and saturated fat. It is one of the worst processed meats for blood pressure. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Salami ina chumvi nyingi mno (mg 1800+) na mafuta yaliyoshiba. Ni miongoni mwa nyama zilizosindikwa zilizo mbaya zaidi kwa presha. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Canned sardines in oil are very high in sodium (500mg+ per 100g) and the oil adds saturated fat. Choose fresh sardines or water-packed varieties instead.
alert_message_sw: Sardines zilizowekwa kwenye mafuta ni za chumvi nyingi (mg 500+) na mafuta ya kutosha. Chagua mbichi au zilizowekwa kwenye maji.

alert_message_en: Canned anchovies in oil are extremely high in sodium (often 3000mg+ per 100g). Even small amounts can cause dangerous blood pressure spikes. Use fresh fish instead.
alert_message_sw: Anchovies zilizowekwa kwenye mafuta ni za chumvi nyingi mno (mara nyingi mg 3000+). Hata kiasi kidogo kinaweza kupandisha presha kwa hatari. Tumia samaki mbichi.

alert_message_en: Pickles are extremely high in sodium (1200mg+ per 100g) due to the brining process. They cause rapid blood pressure elevation. HTN patients should avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Mcharifu ni wa chumvi nyingi mno (mg 1200+) kutokana na mchakato wa kuweka kwenye chumvi. Hupandisha presha kwa kasi. Wenye presha wanapaswa kuiepuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Canned olives are high in sodium (700mg+ per 100g) from the brining liquid. Rinse well before eating and limit to very small portions.
alert_message_sw: Mizeituni ya kopo ni ya chumvi nyingi (mg 700+) kutokana na maji ya kuwekea. Sua vizuri kabla ya kula na kiasi kidogo sana.

alert_message_en: Instant ramen noodles are extremely high in sodium (often 2000mg+ per package from the seasoning). This is one of the worst foods for hypertension. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Tambi za rameni zilizotayarishwa ni za chumvi nyingi mno (mara nyingi mg 2000+ kutokana na viungo). Ni miongoni mwa vyakula vibaya zaidi kwa presha. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Pizza is very high in sodium from cheese, processed meat, and dough. One slice can contain 600-800mg of sodium. Avoid or choose vegetable-only versions with minimal cheese.
alert_message_sw: Pizza ni ya chumvi nyingi kutokana na jibini, nyama zilizosindikwa, na unga. Kipande kimoja kinaweza kuwa na mg 600-800 za chumvi. Epuka au chagua ya mboga tu.

alert_message_en: Beef burgers with cheese are very high in sodium from the meat patty, cheese, and bun. They also contain high saturated fat. A major risk factor for blood pressure spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Burger ya nyama na jibini ni ya chumvi nyingi kutokana na nyama, jibini, na mkate. Pia lina mafuta yaliyoshiba. Sababu kuu ya presha ya juu. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Hot dogs are highly processed, extremely high in sodium (600mg+ each), and contain nitrates. They are dangerous for blood pressure control. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Hot dog zinasindikwa sana, ni za chumvi nyingi mno (mg 600+ kila moja), na zina nitrati. Ni hatari kwa udhibiti wa presha. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Coconut cream is very high in saturated fat (25g+ per 100g) which raises bad cholesterol and contributes to arterial stiffness and high blood pressure. Use very sparingly.
alert_message_sw: Mafuta ya nazi ni ya mafuta yaliyoshiba (g 25+ kwa kila 100g) yanayopandisha kolestrol mbaya na kuchangia kuziba kwa mishipa. Tumia kwa kiasi kidogo sana.

alert_message_en: Ghee is very high in saturated fat (60g+ per 100g) which raises bad cholesterol and increases arterial stiffness, contributing to high blood pressure. Use very sparingly.
alert_message_sw: Ghee lina mafuta yaliyoshiba sana (g 60+ kwa kila 100g) yanayopandisha kolestrol mbaya na kufanya mishipa kuwa ngumu, kuchangia presha ya juu. Tumia kwa kiasi kidogo sana.

alert_message_en: Vegetable shortening contains industrial trans fats which raise bad cholesterol, lower good cholesterol, and significantly increase heart disease and blood pressure risk. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Mafuta ya shortening ya mboga yana trans fats ya viwandani yanayopandisha kolestrol mbaya, kupunguza kolestrol nzuri, na kuongeza hatari ya magonjwa ya moyo na presha. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Mayonnaise is high in fat and often contains added salt. One tablespoon can have 100mg+ of sodium. Use very small amounts or choose low-sodium versions.
alert_message_sw: Mayonnaise ni ya mafuta mengi na mara nyingi huwa na chumvi iliyoongezwa. Kijiko kimoja cha chakula kinaweza kuwa na mg 100+ za chumvi. Tumia kiasi kidogo sana.

alert_message_en: French salad dressing is high in sodium, sugar, and fat. It can add hidden sodium to otherwise healthy salads. Use oil and vinegar sparingly instead.
alert_message_sw: Sala dressing ya Kifaransa ni ya chumvi nyingi, sukari, na mafuta. Inaweza kuongeza chumvi iliyofichwa kwenye saladi zilizo za afya. Tumia mafuta na vinigiri kidogo.

alert_message_en: Bread rolls often contain hidden sodium (300-500mg per roll) for preservation and flavor. Choose whole-grain versions and limit to one small roll.
alert_message_sw: Mikate ya bun mara nyingi huwa na chumvi iliyofichwa (mg 300-500 kwa bun) kwa uhifadhi na ladha. Chagua za ngano nzima na kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Vermicelli with coconut milk and salt contains added sodium from the salt. The coconut milk also adds saturated fat. Use unsalted versions with minimal coconut milk.
alert_message_sw: Tambi za vermicelli za nazi na chumvi zina chumvi iliyoongezwa. Maziwa ya nazi pia huongeza mafuta yaliyoshiba. Tumia zisizo na chumvi na nazi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Rice biryani often contains high amounts of salt and oil for seasoning. One serving can have 800mg+ of sodium. Request low-salt preparation or choose plain rice.
alert_message_sw: Biryani ya mchele mara nyingi huwa na chumvi nyingi na mafuta kwa ajili ya viungo. Kipimo kimoja kinaweza kuwa na mg 800+ za chumvi. Omba kupikwa kwa chumvi kidogo au chagua wali wa kawaida.

alert_message_en: Rice and meat pilau is seasoned with salt and often cooked with oil or ghee. It can be very high in sodium and saturated fat. Request minimal salt preparation.
alert_message_sw: Pilau ya wali na nyama huwekwa chumvi na mara nyingi hupikwa kwa mafuta au ghee. Inaweza kuwa na chumvi nyingi na mafuta yaliyoshiba. Omba kupikwa kwa chumvi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Canned tuna contains added sodium (300mg+ per 100g) even when packed in water. Rinse well before eating or choose fresh tuna when possible.
alert_message_sw: Tuna ya kopo lina chumvi iliyoongezwa (mg 300+ kwa kila 100g) hata ikawa imewekwa kwenye maji. Sua vizuri kabla ya kula au chagua tuna mbichi iwezekanavyo.

alert_message_en: Dry chapati (Indian style) often contains salt in the dough and is cooked with oil or ghee. Choose chapati made without salt and with minimal oil.
alert_message_sw: Chapati kavu (mtindo wa Kihindi) mara nyingi huwa na chumvi kwenye unga na hupikwa kwa mafuta au ghee. Chagua chapati zisizo na chumvi na mafuta kidogo.

alert_message_en: Cracked maize (sima) is high-GI starch that causes rapid blood sugar spikes. Control portion to one cup and pair with leafy greens to slow absorption.
alert_message_sw: Mahindi yaliyopigwa (sima) ni wanga wa GI ya juu unaopandisha sukari damuni kwa kasi. Dhibiti kiasi kisichozidi kikombe kimoja na ule kwa mboga za majani.

alert_message_en: Yellow maize flour is high-GI refined starch. It breaks down quickly into sugar in the blood. Control portion size (fist-sized) and pair with vegetables.
alert_message_sw: Unga wa mahindi ya njano ni wanga wa GI ya juu unaovunjika haraka kuwa sukari damuni. Dhibiti kiasi (ukubwa wa ngumi) na ule kwa mboga.

alert_message_en: Semolina is high-GI refined wheat that causes rapid blood sugar spikes. Use small portions and pair with protein or vegetables to slow absorption.
alert_message_sw: Semolina ni ngano iliyosafishwa ya GI ya juu inayopandisha sukari haraka. Tumia kiasi kidogo na ule na protini au mboga ili kupunguza kasi.

alert_message_en: Macaroni and spaghetti are moderate-to-high GI refined pasta. Portion control is essential for DM patients. Limit to one cup cooked and add vegetables.
alert_message_sw: Macaroni na spaghetti ni tamabili za GI ya wastani-juu zilizosafishwa. Udhibiti wa kiasi ni muhimu. Kiasi kisichozidi kikombe kimoja kilichopikwa na ongeza mboga.

alert_message_en: Dry chapati is made with refined white flour (maida) which has a high GI. It causes blood sugar spikes. Choose whole-wheat chapati or limit to one small piece.
alert_message_sw: Chapati kavu huitengenezwa kwa unga mweupe uliosafishwa unaojiriki haraka. Hupandisha sukari damuni. Chagua chapati ya ngano nzima au kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Maize porridge (even without sugar) is high-GI and breaks down quickly into glucose. It can cause significant blood sugar spikes. Limit portion and add groundnuts for protein.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa mahindi (hata bila sukari) ni wa GI ya juu na huvunjika haraka kuwa sukari. Inaweza kupandisha sukari sana. Punguza kiasi na ongeza karanga kwa protini.

alert_message_en: Sorghum and millet ugali is high-GI starchy food. While sorghum has some fiber, the overall glycemic impact is significant. Control portion to fist-size and eat with vegetables.
alert_message_sw: Ugali wa mtama na ulezi ni chakula cha wanga wa GI ya juu. Ingawa mtama lina nyuzi, athari ya sukari ni kubwa. Kiasi kama ngumi na ule kwa mboga.

alert_message_en: Dried cassava is very high in starch (80g+ carbs per 100g) and has a high glycemic impact. It causes significant blood sugar spikes. Limit to very small portions.
alert_message_sw: Mhogo mkavu lina wanga mwingi sana (g 80+ kwa kila 100g) na lina athari kubwa ya sukari. Hupandisha sukari sana. Kiasi kidogo sana.

alert_message_en: English potato is high-GI starch that breaks down quickly into sugar. Boiled potato has a lower GI than mashed but still requires portion control. Limit to one medium potato.
alert_message_sw: Viazi viringo ni wanga wa GI ya juu unaovunjika haraka kuwa sukari. Viazi vilivyochemshwa lina GI ya chini kuliko vilivyopondwa lakini bado dhibiti kiasi. Kiasi kimoja cha wastani.

alert_message_en: Cooked green banana (matoke) is high in starch and has a moderate-to-high GI. While it provides some resistant starch, portion control is important for DM patients.
alert_message_sw: Ndizi ya kupika lina wanga mwingi na lina GI ya wastani-juu. Ingawa lina wanga usioshika vizuri, udhibiti wa kiasi ni muhimu kwa wenye kisukari.

alert_message_en: Bread rolls are made with refined white flour and often contain added sugar. They have a high GI and cause rapid blood sugar spikes. Choose whole-grain versions or limit to one small roll.
alert_message_sw: Mkate wa bun huitengenezwa kwa unga mweupe ulio safishwa na mara nyingi huwa na sukari iliyoongezwa. Lina GI ya juu na hupandisha sukari haraka. Chagua wa ngano nzima au kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Maize porridge without sugar is still high-GI and breaks down quickly into glucose. The lack of fiber means rapid absorption. Limit portion and add protein like groundnuts.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa mahindi bila sukari bado ni wa GI ya juu na huvunjika haraka kuwa sukari. Ukosefu wa nyuzi unamaanisha unyonyaji wa haraka. Punguza kiasi na ongeza protini kama karanga.

alert_message_en: Maize porridge with sugar and egg combines high-GI starch with refined sugar — a double threat to blood glucose. The egg adds some protein but not enough to offset the sugar impact. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa mahindi na sukari na yai unachanganya wanga wa GI ya juu na sukari — tishio mara mbili kwa sukari damu. Yai huongeza protini lakini sio ya kutosha. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Maize porridge with sugar and milk combines high-GI starch with refined sugar and lactose. This creates a triple sugar threat that causes severe blood glucose spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa mahindi na sukari na maziwa unachanganya wanga wa GI ya juu, sukari, na lactose. Huumba tishio mara tatu la sukari linalopandisha sukari sana. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Millet porridge with sugar combines high-GI grain with refined sugar. Both components cause rapid blood sugar spikes. This is very dangerous for glucose control. Avoid or use no sugar.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa ulezi na sukari unachanganya nafaka ya GI ya juu na sukari. Viwango vyote viwili vinapandisha sukari haraka. Ni hatari sana kwa udhibiti wa sukari. Epuka au usitumie sukari.

alert_message_en: Mixed flour porridge with sugar combines multiple high-GI starches with refined sugar. This creates an extreme glycemic load. Avoid completely or make without any sugar.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa unga mchanganywa na sukari unachanganya wanga mwingi wa GI ya juu na sukari. Huumba mzigo mkubwa wa sukari. Epuka kabisa au utengenezwe bila sukari.

alert_message_en: Pancakes are made with refined white flour and sugar, creating a high-GI food that causes rapid blood sugar spikes. They are also often fried in oil. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Pankeki huitengenezwa kwa unga mweupe na sukari, kuunda chakula cha GI ya juu. Mara nyingi huwa yamekaangwa kwa mafuta. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Rice biryani uses white rice which is high-GI. The oil and seasonings add extra calories. Limit to one cup and prioritize the meat/vegetable components over the rice.
alert_message_sw: Biryani ya mchele hutumia mchele mweupe wa GI ya juu. Mafuta na viungo huongeza kalori. Kiasi kisichozidi kikombe kimoja na pendelea nyama/mboga zaidi ya mchele.

alert_message_en: Rice and meat pilau uses high-GI white rice with added oil — avoid for diabetes. Choose sorghum, millet, green banana, or magimbi instead.
alert_message_sw: Pilau ya wali na nyama hutumia mchele mweupe wa GI ya juu. Mafuta ya kupikia huongeza mafuta zaidi. Kiasi kisichozidi kikombe kimoja na jaza sahani kwa mboga zisizo na wanga.

alert_message_en: Chicken biryani uses high-GI white rice with oil and seasoning — avoid for diabetes. Choose magimbi, sorghum, millet, or boiled fish with greens instead.
alert_message_sw: Biriani ya kuku hutumia mchele mweupe wa GI ya juu na mafuta — epuka kwa kisukari. Chagua magimbi, mtama, ulezi, au samaki wa kuchemsha na mboga badala yake.

alert_message_en: Rice ugali is high-GI starchy food made from white rice flour. It breaks down quickly into glucose. Control portion to fist-size and always eat with plenty of vegetables.
alert_message_sw: Ugali wa mchele ni chakula cha wanga wa GI ya juu kilichotengenezwa kwa unga wa mchele mweupe. Huvunjika haraka kuwa sukari. Kiasi kama ngumi na ule kwa mboga nyingi.

alert_message_en: Vermicelli is made from refined wheat and is high-GI. It causes rapid blood sugar spikes similar to white rice. Limit portion and add vegetables or protein.
alert_message_sw: Tambi za vermicelli zimetengenezwa kwa ngano iliyosafishwa na ni za GI ya juu. Hupandisha sukari haraka kama mchele mweupe. Punguza kiasi na ongeza mboga au protini.

alert_message_en: Wheat porridge is made from refined wheat flour and is high-GI. It breaks down quickly into glucose. Choose whole-grain versions or add groundnuts to slow absorption.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa ngano huitengenezwa kwa unga wa ngano ulio safishwa na ni wa GI ya juu. Huvunjika haraka kuwa sukari. Chagua wa ngano nzima au ongeza karanga kupunguza kasi.

alert_message_en: Boiled cassava is very high in starch (40g+ carbs per 100g) and has a high glycemic impact. It causes significant blood sugar spikes. Limit to very small portions.
alert_message_sw: Mhogo uliochemshwa lina wanga mwingi sana (g 40+ kwa kila 100g) na lina athari kubwa ya sukari. Hupandisha sukari sana. Kiasi kidogo sana.

alert_message_en: Cassava stiff porridge (ugali) is extremely high in starch and has a very high glycemic impact. It is one of the most challenging foods for blood sugar control. Limit to fist-size portion.
alert_message_sw: Ugali wa mhogo lina wanga mwingi sana na lina athari kubwa sana ya sukari. Ni miongoni mwa vyakula vigumu zaidi kwa udhibiti wa sukari. Kiasi kama ngumi.

alert_message_en: Rice and chicken biryani combines high-GI white rice with fatty meat and oil. This creates a dangerous glycemic and caloric load. Limit to one cup and prioritize chicken over rice.
alert_message_sw: Biryani ya mchele na kuku inachanganya mchele mweupe wa GI ya juu na nyama yenye mafuta. Huumba mzigo mkubwa wa sukari na kalori. Kiasi kisichozidi kikombe kimoja.

alert_message_en: Dried red dates are extremely high in concentrated sugar (60g+ sugar per 100g). They cause severe blood sugar spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Tarehe nyekundu zilizokauka ni za sukari nyingi mno zilizochanganywa (g 60+ kwa kila 100g). Hupandisha sukari sana. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Yellow dates are very high in natural sugar. Even small amounts can cause significant blood sugar spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Tarehe za njano ni za sukari nyingi sana asilia. Hata kiasi kidogo kinaweza kupandisha sukari sana. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Durian is very high in sugar and fat. It causes dangerous blood sugar spikes and contributes to weight gain. DM patients should avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Durian lina sukari nyingi sana na mafuta. Hupandisha sukari kwa hatari na kuongeza uzito. Wagonjwa wa kisukari wanapaswa kuiepuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Mango juice is a concentrated source of sugar without the fiber of whole fruit. One glass can contain 3-4 mangoes worth of sugar. Avoid completely; eat whole mango instead.
alert_message_sw: Juisi ya embe ni chanzo cha sukari iliyochanganywa bila nyuzi za tunda zima. Glasi moja inaweza kuwa na sukari ya embe 3-4. Epuka kabisa; kula embe zima badala yake.

alert_message_en: Concentrated orange juice has a very high sugar concentration and no fiber to slow absorption. It causes rapid blood sugar spikes. Choose whole oranges instead.
alert_message_sw: Juisi ya chungwa iliyochanganywa ina sukari nyingi sana na hakuna nyuzi za kupunguza unyonyaji. Hupandisha sukari haraka. Chagua machungwa zima badala yake.

alert_message_en: Apple juice is a concentrated sugar source without the fiber of whole apples. Even 100% natural juice causes blood sugar spikes. Eat whole apples instead.
alert_message_sw: Juisi ya tofaa ni chanzo cha sukari iliyochanganywa bila nyuzi za tunda zima. Hata juisi ya asili inapandisha sukari. Kula matofaa zima badala yake.

alert_message_en: Grape juice is extremely high in sugar (15g+ per 100ml) and has no fiber. It causes rapid blood sugar spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Juisi ya zabibu ina sukari nyingi sana (g 15+ kwa kila ml 100) na hakuna nyuzi. Hupandisha sukari haraka. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Mixed fruit jam is essentially concentrated sugar (50g+ per 100g) with minimal fruit content. It causes severe blood sugar spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Jamu ya matunda mchanganyo ni sukari iliyochanganywa (g 50+ kwa kila 100g) na matunda kidogo. Hupandisha sukari sana. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Mixed fruit juice combines multiple fruit sugars in a fiber-free liquid form. It causes rapid and severe blood sugar spikes. Avoid completely; eat whole fruit instead.
alert_message_sw: Juisi ya matunda mchanganyo inachanganya sukari za matunda kadhaa kwenye kioevu bila nyuzi. Hupandisha sukari haraka na sana. Epuka kabisa; kula matunda zima.

alert_message_en: Ice cream is extremely high in sugar (20g+ per 100g) and fat. It causes severe blood sugar spikes and contributes to weight gain. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Aiskrimu ina sukari nyingi sana (g 20+ kwa kila 100g) na mafuta. Hupandisha sukari sana na kuongeza uzito. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Custard powder is mostly cornstarch and sugar. It is a highly refined carbohydrate that causes rapid blood sugar spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Unga wa custard ni wanga wa mahindi na sukari. Ni wanga uliosafishwa sana unaopandisha sukari haraka. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Cornflakes are made from refined corn and are high-GI. They cause rapid blood sugar spikes. Often contain added sugar and salt. Choose whole-grain cereals or oatmeal instead.
alert_message_sw: Cornflakes zimetengenezwa kwa mahindi yaliyosafishwa na ni za GI ya juu. Hupandisha sukari haraka. Mara nyingi huwa na sukari na chumvi. Chagua nafaka za ngano nzima au oatmeal.

alert_message_en: Muesli often contains dried fruits and added sugars that increase the glycemic load. Even without added sugar, the dried fruit concentrate makes it challenging for DM. Check labels carefully.
alert_message_sw: Muesli mara nyingi huwa na matunda yaliyokauka na sukari zinazozidisha mzigo wa sukari. Hata bila sukari, matunda yaliyokauka huifanya kuwa ngumu kwa kisukari. Angalia lebo.

alert_message_en: Dried grapes (raisins) are extremely concentrated sugar (60g+ per 100g) with no water content. A small handful equals multiple fresh grapes in sugar. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Zabibu zilizokauka (zabibisho) ni sukari iliyochanganywa sana (g 60+ kwa kila 100g) bila maji. Kipande kidogo ni sawa na zabibu nyingi za mbichi kwa sukari. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Dried apricots are very high in concentrated sugar (40g+ per 100g). The drying process removes water, concentrating the sugar content. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Apricots zilizokauka ni za sukari nyingi zilizochanganywa (g 40+ kwa kila 100g). Mchakato wa kukausha huondoa maji, kuchanganya sukari. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Dried prunes are very high in concentrated sugar (40g+ per 100g). While they have fiber, the sugar concentration is still dangerous for DM patients. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Prunes zilizokauka ni za sukari nyingi zilizochanganywa (g 40+ kwa kila 100g). Ingawa lina nyuzi, changamoto ya sukari bado ni hatari kwa wenye kisukari. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Dried figs are extremely high in concentrated sugar (50g+ per 100g). They are one of the most sugar-dense dried fruits. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Figs zilizokauka ni za sukari nyingi sana zilizochanganywa (g 50+ kwa kila 100g). Ni miongoni mwa matunda yaliyokauka yenye sukari nyingi zaidi. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Ketchup (tomato sauce) is very high in added sugar (20g+ per 100g). It is a hidden source of sugar that adds up quickly. Use very sparingly or choose sugar-free versions.
alert_message_sw: Ketchup (sosi ya nyanya) ni wa sukari nyingi iliyoongezwa (g 20+ kwa kila 100g). Ni chanzo cha sukari iliyofichwa inayoongezeka haraka. Tumia kidogo sana au chagua asiye na sukari.

alert_message_en: Pizza combines high-GI refined flour crust with high-fat cheese and often sugary tomato sauce. This triple threat causes severe blood sugar spikes. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Pizza inachanganya unga wa juu wa GI wa unga uliosafishwa, jibini la mafuta mengi, na sosi wa nyanya wenye sukari. Tishio mara tatu hili hupandisha sukari sana. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Instant ramen noodles are made from refined wheat and the seasoning contains sugar. The noodles are high-GI and the meal is very high in calories. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Tambi za rameni zilizotayarishwa zimetengenezwa kwa ngano iliyosafishwa na viungo vina sukari. Tambi ni za GI ya juu na chakula lina kalori nyingi. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Pad Thai uses rice noodles which are high-GI, and the sauce contains sugar. It causes significant blood sugar spikes. Limit to small portions or choose vegetable-based alternatives.
alert_message_sw: Pad Thai hutumia tambi za mchele ambazo ni za GI ya juu, na sosi lina sukari. Hupandisha sukari sana. Punguza kiasi au chagua za mboga.

alert_message_en: Sorghum porridge with sugar combines a moderate-GI grain with refined sugar. The added sugar makes this very dangerous for blood glucose control. Avoid or make without sugar.
alert_message_sw: Uji wa mtama na sukari unachanganya nafaka ya GI ya wastani na sukari. Sukari iliyoongezwa hufanya kuwa hatari sana kwa udhibiti wa sukari. Epuka au utengenezwe bila sukari.

alert_message_en: Red wine contains alcohol and sugar. Alcohol can cause unpredictable blood sugar fluctuations — it may drop sugar initially then spike later. Avoid completely.
alert_message_sw: Mvinyo wa nyekundu lina kileo na sukari. Kileo kinaweza kusababisha mabadiliko ya kisichotarajiwa ya sukari — kunaweza kushuka kwanza kisha kupanda. Epuka kabisa.

alert_message_en: Grapes are high in natural sugar (15g+ per 100g). While they contain some fiber, the sugar content is significant. Limit to a small bunch (10-12 grapes) at a time.
alert_message_sw: Zabibu ni za sukari nyingi asilia (g 15+ kwa kila 100g). Ingawa lina nyuzi, kiasi cha sukari ni kikubwa. Kiasi kidogo (zabibu 10-12) kwa wakati mmoja.

alert_message_en: Biscuit: High sodium content (1302mg per 100g) raises blood pressure by causing water retention and constricting blood vessels. TIP: Limit portion to half normal size, rinse if possible, and pair with potassium-rich vegetables like spinach or banana to counter sodium effects.
alert_message_sw: Biskuti: Ina chumvi nyingi (1302mg kwa 100g) inayopandisha presha kwa kushikilia maji na kufunga mishipa. TIP: Kiasi nusu ya kawaida, oshea iwezekanavyo, na kula pamoja na mboga za potasiamu kama mchicha au ndizi.

alert_message_en: Biscuit: High glycemic index with 71.5g carbs per 100g causes rapid blood sugar spikes. TIP: Reduce portion by half, pair with protein or healthy fats to slow absorption, or choose whole grain alternatives like brown rice or sorghum ugali.
alert_message_sw: Biskuti: Kiwango cha juu cha sukari na 71.5g wanga kwa 100g husababisha kupanda kwa haraka kwa sukari ya damu. TIP: Punguza kiasi nusu, kula pamoja na protini au mafuta salama, au chagua badala kama mchele wa kuchanganya au ugali wa mtama.

alert_message_en: Biscuit: Contains concentrated sugars that cause immediate blood sugar spikes with little nutritional value. TIP: Avoid completely. If craving sweetness, use small amounts of stevia or eat whole fruits like berries in controlled portions.
alert_message_sw: Biskuti: Ina sukari zilizounganishwa zinazosababisha kupanda kwa haraka kwa sukari ya damu bila thamani ya lishe. TIP: Epuka kabisa. Ukihitaji utamu, tumia stevia kidogo au la matunda yote kama berries kwa kiasi cha kudhibitiwa.

alert_message_sw: Aspirin pamoja na pombe huongeza hatari ya kuwashwa tumbo na kutokwa damu. Epuka bia, hasa ukiwa na dalili za vidonda au unatumia aspirin kila siku.

alert_message_en: Aspirin plus wine or alcohol increases the risk of stomach bleeding. Avoid alcohol if you take aspirin regularly.
alert_message_sw: Aspirin pamoja na divai au pombe huongeza hatari ya kutokwa damu tumboni. Epuka pombe kama unatumia aspirin mara kwa mara.

alert_message_en: Hot pepper can irritate the stomach. With aspirin, this may worsen gastritis or ulcer symptoms; use mild foods if you have stomach pain.
alert_message_sw: Pilipili kali inaweza kuwasha tumbo. Ukiwa unatumia aspirin, inaweza kuzidisha gastritis au vidonda; tumia vyakula visivyochoma ukiwa na maumivu ya tumbo.

alert_message_en: Hydrochlorothiazide works best with sodium restriction. Dried dagaa is very salty; rinse well and keep the portion small.
alert_message_sw: Hydrochlorothiazide hufanya kazi vizuri zaidi ukipunguza chumvi. Dagaa wakavu wana chumvi nyingi; oshea vizuri na kula kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Sausage is high in sodium and can reduce blood pressure control while taking hydrochlorothiazide. Choose fresh lean protein instead.
alert_message_sw: Soseji ina chumvi nyingi na inaweza kupunguza udhibiti wa presha ukiwa unatumia hydrochlorothiazide. Chagua protini safi isiyo na mafuta mengi.

alert_message_en: Added salt directly works against hydrochlorothiazide blood pressure control. Avoid adding salt at the table.
alert_message_sw: Kuongeza chumvi hupingana moja kwa moja na udhibiti wa presha wa hydrochlorothiazide. Epuka kuongeza chumvi mezani.

alert_message_en: Furosemide is used to remove extra fluid; very salty foods like dried dagaa can worsen fluid retention and blood pressure.
alert_message_sw: Furosemide hutumika kutoa maji ya ziada mwilini; vyakula vyenye chumvi nyingi kama dagaa wakavu vinaweza kuongeza kubaki kwa maji na presha.

alert_message_en: Added salt can worsen swelling and blood pressure while taking furosemide. Avoid adding salt and choose low-sodium foods.
alert_message_sw: Kuongeza chumvi kunaweza kuzidisha uvimbe na presha ukiwa unatumia furosemide. Epuka kuongeza chumvi na chagua vyakula vya chumvi kidogo.

alert_message_en: High-sodium foods can reduce blood pressure control while taking lisinopril. Rinse dried dagaa and keep portions small.
alert_message_sw: Vyakula vya chumvi nyingi vinaweza kupunguza udhibiti wa presha ukiwa unatumia lisinopril. Oshea dagaa wakavu na kula kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Added salt can work against lisinopril blood pressure control. Avoid adding salt at the table.
alert_message_sw: Kuongeza chumvi kunaweza kupunguza udhibiti wa presha wa lisinopril. Epuka kuongeza chumvi mezani.

alert_message_en: High-sodium foods can reduce blood pressure control while taking enalapril. Rinse dried dagaa and keep portions small.
alert_message_sw: Vyakula vya chumvi nyingi vinaweza kupunguza udhibiti wa presha ukiwa unatumia enalapril. Oshea dagaa wakavu na kula kiasi kidogo.

alert_message_en: Added salt can work against enalapril blood pressure control. Avoid adding salt at the table.
alert_message_sw: Kuongeza chumvi kunaweza kupunguza udhibiti wa presha wa enalapril. Epuka kuongeza chumvi mezani.

alert_message_en: Alcohol can worsen nausea, liver stress, and missed doses while taking ARVs. Avoid beer or keep strictly to clinician advice.
alert_message_sw: Pombe inaweza kuongeza kichefuchefu, mzigo kwenye ini, na kusababisha kuruka dozi ukiwa unatumia ARV. Epuka bia au fuata ushauri wa daktari.

alert_message_en: Alcohol can worsen ARV side effects and adherence. Avoid wine or other alcohol unless your clinician says it is safe.
alert_message_sw: Pombe inaweza kuzidisha madhara ya ARV na kupunguza ufuasi wa dawa. Epuka divai au pombe nyingine isipokuwa daktari ameruhusu.

alert_message_en: Hot pepper can worsen nausea or stomach upset for some people taking ARVs. Choose milder foods if you have GI side effects.
alert_message_sw: Pilipili kali inaweza kuongeza kichefuchefu au tumbo kuchafuka kwa baadhi ya watumiaji wa ARV. Chagua vyakula visivyochoma kama una madhara ya tumbo.

alert_message_en: Spironolactone can raise blood potassium. Banana is potassium-rich; keep portions moderate and follow clinician potassium advice, especially with kidney disease.
alert_message_sw: Spironolactone inaweza kuongeza potasiamu kwenye damu. Ndizi ina potasiamu nyingi; kula kiasi cha wastani na fuata ushauri wa daktari hasa ukiwa na tatizo la figo.

alert_message_en: Losartan may increase potassium. Avocado is potassium-rich; avoid very large portions if kidney function is reduced or potassium is being monitored.
alert_message_sw: Losartan inaweza kuongeza potasiamu. Parachichi lina potasiamu nyingi; epuka kiasi kikubwa kama figo zimepungua nguvu au potasiamu inafuatiliwa.

alert_message_en: Some statins interact with grapefruit/citrus and may increase side effects. If you take simvastatin or atorvastatin, ask your clinician before regular large portions.
alert_message_sw: Baadhi ya statin huingiliana na matunda ya grapefruit/machungwa na kuongeza madhara. Ukitumia simvastatin au atorvastatin, muulize daktari kabla ya kula mara kwa mara kwa kiasi kikubwa.

alert_message_en: NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or diclofenac plus alcohol increase stomach bleeding and ulcer risk. Avoid beer while using these medicines.
alert_message_sw: NSAID kama ibuprofen au diclofenac pamoja na pombe huongeza hatari ya vidonda na kutokwa damu tumboni. Epuka bia ukiwa unatumia dawa hizi.

alert_message_en: Rifampicin and alcohol both stress the liver. Avoid alcohol during TB treatment unless your clinician specifically advises otherwise.
alert_message_sw: Rifampicin na pombe zote huathiri ini. Epuka pombe wakati wa matibabu ya TB isipokuwa daktari ameshauri vinginevyo.

alert_message_en: Isoniazid and alcohol increase liver toxicity risk. Avoid wine and other alcohol during TB treatment.
alert_message_sw: Isoniazid pamoja na pombe huongeza hatari ya sumu kwenye ini. Epuka divai na pombe nyingine wakati wa matibabu ya TB.

alert_message_en: Metronidazole can cause severe nausea, flushing, and palpitations with alcohol. Avoid beer during treatment and for at least 48 hours after finishing.
alert_message_sw: Metronidazole inaweza kusababisha kichefuchefu kali, mwili kuwaka moto, na mapigo kwenda kasi ukinywa pombe. Epuka bia wakati wa dawa na angalau saa 48 baada ya kumaliza.

alert_message_en: Quinolone antibiotics such as ciprofloxacin bind with calcium and absorb poorly. Separate milk or calcium-rich foods from the dose by at least 2 hours.
alert_message_sw: Antibiotiki za quinolone kama ciprofloxacin hushikamana na calcium na hufyonzwa vibaya. Tenganisha maziwa au vyakula vyenye calcium na dozi kwa angalau saa 2.

alert_message_en: Your latest HbA1c suggests uncontrolled diabetes. White rice can raise glucose quickly; keep portions small and pair with vegetables and protein.
alert_message_sw: HbA1c yako ya karibuni inaonyesha kisukari hakijadhibitiwa vizuri. Wali mweupe unaweza kupandisha sukari haraka; punguza kiasi na kula pamoja na mboga na protini.

alert_message_en: With uncontrolled diabetes, sweetened maize porridge is high-risk because it combines refined starch and sugar. Choose unsweetened, smaller portions with protein instead.
alert_message_sw: Kisukari kisipodhibitiwa, uji wa mahindi wenye sukari ni hatari kwa sababu una wanga na sukari. Chagua uji usio na sukari, kiasi kidogo, pamoja na protini.

alert_message_en: Your latest blood pressure is in a severe range. Dried dagaa is very high in sodium; rinse well, use a small spoon portion, and avoid adding salt.
alert_message_sw: Shinikizo lako la damu la karibuni liko juu sana. Dagaa kavu ana chumvi nyingi; osha vizuri, tumia kiasi kidogo cha kijiko, na usiongeze chumvi.

alert_message_en: Moderate kidney impairment may require potassium control. Banana is potassium-rich; keep portions small unless your clinician allows more.
alert_message_sw: Figo zikipungua uwezo kwa wastani, potasiamu inaweza kuhitaji kudhibitiwa. Ndizi ina potasiamu nyingi; kula kiasi kidogo isipokuwa daktari ameruhusu zaidi.

alert_message_en: Severe kidney impairment makes high-potassium foods risky. Avoid banana unless your renal clinician has specifically allowed it.
alert_message_sw: Figo zikipungua sana, vyakula vyenye potasiamu nyingi ni hatari. Epuka ndizi isipokuwa daktari wa figo ameruhusu wazi.
